title: Old Quebec Art Galleries Private Walking Tour
includes: Licensed Private Local guide for 3 to 3,5 hours
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
A maximum of 8 people per booking
policies: A moderate amount of walking is involved, Comfortable walking shoes are recommended
Operates in all weather conditions, please dress appropriately
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Explore the artistic world of Old Quebec, a UNESCO World Heritage Site, on an immersive private art galleries walking tour. You’ll dive into the fascinating world of local and international artisans and painters with their unique creations. From the rich history of the cobbled streets to the contemporary exhibitions that enliven the walls, this tour offers an unforgettable experience, blending history and art. The galleries are selected for their diverse styles and origins to offer the best representation of the quality found in Old Quebec.

If the funicular is closed, we can arrange cab transport to avoid having to walk up the hill, or we can provide a ticket to be used later in the stay, at the customer's discretion (if they wish to walk up). 

A 15-20% tip is strongly recommended at the end of the visit.
